addable.name: Aresium
addable.blurb: Personal finance from your bank's own exports — imported, sorted and understood.

detail.about: The empire's personal-finance command. Aresium reads the exports of 25 German banks and PayPal, with no bank login and no aggregator in between, sorts every payment into a category by itself and learns from each correction. It shows spending and income by month and category, the monthly average and the fixed costs. A website and an iPhone app; on the iPhone the data stays on the device.
features: CSV, CAMT and MT940 from 25 German banks, and PayPal
Sorts by itself with known shops and local places, learns from every correction
Spending and income by month and category, each day's payments
The monthly average and the fixed costs, found on their own
Quick sort, many payments at once, money paid back linked to its expense
On the iPhone: data on the device, Face ID lock, receipts from a photo

addable.name: Arestemis
addable.blurb: Searches that run for you — flats, things for sale, prices and web pages.

detail.about: The huntress. Arestemis runs searches from the iPhone: flats and WG rooms on the housing portals, things for sale on marketplaces such as Kleinanzeigen, Vinted and eBay, a product's price in one shop or across shops, and any web page, watched for a change described in words. Every new find is checked against the whole search, first by its fields and then by an AI reading its full text, and a push arrives when one fits. It began as FlatSniper, a Telegram bot for flats.
features: Flats and WG rooms on WG-Gesucht, Kleinanzeigen, Immowelt and ImmoScout24
Things for sale on Kleinanzeigen, Vinted, eBay and more, with what must be and what would be nice
Preismonitor: a product's price in one shop or across shops, with a push under a chosen price
Page watch: any web page, for a change described in words
An AI check of every new find, and a push when one fits
